# Locked design language + buildable UI/UX spec, no AI slop

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the repo states no license, so no content is reproduced): @ulpi-io's frontend-design-ui-ux skill — a DESIGN-SPEC skill with non-negotiable rules, not an implementation skill. The workflow: discovery and inputs (target users, goal, context — ask once for reference URLs), optional inspiration intake (visit links with the browse skill, extract design DNA, synthesize — never clone one), design read and aesthetic direction (commit to ONE named direction from the anti-slop menu and pass the counterfactual default test), derive and LOCK the design language (palette in OKLCH, type roles, one spacing/radius/motion scale, the Signature, the voice — written to .ulpi/design/DESIGN.md, re-read every session), model flows and states (primary journey plus loading/empty/error/edge cases into .ulpi/design/<feature>.md), specify components and interaction rules (variants, props, states, responsive, accessibility), run the Design Pre-Flight gate (identity lock, anti-slop, state coverage, scored self-critique — fix anything ticked off), and finish with a build handoff (target engineering agent + acceptance criteria: "implement exactly this spec, do NOT redesign").
